FADE IN:

EXT. OCEAN - DAY

We see a jellyfish, its translucent body glowing in the sunlight, drifting aimlessly through the water. Suddenly, a human, JASON, appears out of nowhere, a fishing net in hand. He scoops up the jellyfish and pulls it out of the water.

JASON
(to himself)
Ah, a beauty. I've never seen one like this before.

The jellyfish, now out of its element, begins to struggle and pulse with a strange, otherworldly energy.

JASON
(laughing)
You're a real fighter, aren't you?

Jason holds the jellyfish up to the sky, where a solar eclipse is about to occur. The jellyfish's eyes, once a soft, ethereal blue, now seem to be staring into the very abyss of existence.

JASON
(to the jellyfish)
Look, my friend. The sun is going to be hidden for a moment. Isn't it beautiful?

The jellyfish's body begins to contort and twist, its tentacles writhing like snakes. It starts to speak in a voice that is both familiar and yet, utterly alien.

JELLYFISH
(whispering)
Oh, the horror... the horror beyond comprehension...

JASON
(confused)
What are you talking about?

JELLYFISH
(its voice growing louder)
The void that lies beyond the veil of reality... the eldritch abominations that lurk in the depths of the abyss... the crushing weight of existence...

Jason's eyes widen in confusion as the jellyfish's monologue becomes more and more frantic.

JELLYFISH
(its voice a cacophony of terror)
I am but a mere mortal, a fleeting moment in the grand tapestry of time... and yet, I am aware of the horrors that lurk beyond the veil... the unspeakable terrors that defy human comprehension...

Jason's grip on the jellyfish begins to falter, and it slips from his grasp. The jellyfish floats away, its body glowing with an otherworldly energy.

JASON
(backing away)
What's going on? What's happening to you?

The jellyfish's voice grows fainter, until it is nothing more than a whisper.

JELLYFISH
(whispering)
I am but a mere shell, a husk of a being... a mere mortal, lost in an infinite expanse of nothingness...

The jellyfish's body begins to dissolve, its form blurring and shifting until it is nothing more than a mere memory.

JASON
(stunned)
What... what just happened?

As the jellyfish disappears, Jason is left standing alone, staring up at the sky. The solar eclipse has passed, and the sun is once again shining brightly.

JASON
(to himself)
I don't know what just happened. But I know one thing... I'll never look at the ocean the same way again.

FADE TO BLACK.

This screenplay is a work of fiction, and any resemblance to actual events or beings is purely coincidental. The concept of trichosis, a rare condition where a person's hair grows in a way that resembles a jellyfish, is not relevant to this story.
